# rms_users (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Teltonika RMS Users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_users" "all" {}

output "usernames" {
  value = data.rms_users.all.users[*].username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.
- `users` (Attributes List) List of users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `company_id` (Number)
- `email` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `role` (String)
- `username` (String)
